title: Impact of CT on Diagnosis of Acute Appendicitis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether computed tomography is reliable investigation in the diagnosis of acute appendicitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have been admitted and diagnosed as having acute appendicitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients under the age of 18 years.
* Pregnancy.
* Uncooperative patients (senile dementia, mentally ill).
* Not speaking Danish.
* Does not wish to participate.
